items.source: Creates a default LettuceClientConfiguration with: SSL no Peer Verification yes Start TLS no Client Options ClientOptions with enabled TimeoutOptions Client Resources none Client name none Read From none Connect Timeout 60 Seconds Shutdown Timeout 100 Milliseconds Shutdown Quiet Period 100 Milliseconds
